results.title: Fr. Griffin's Éire Óg squeeze past Naomh Pádraig An Fhairche
results.description: THE second final of Saturday’s double-header at Pearse Stadium also appeared destined for extra-time before substitute Philip Lennon struck the winning point deep into injury-time to secure a dramatic 0-11 to 0-10 victory for Fr. Griffin’s/Éire Óg over Naomh Pádraig, An Fhairche.

results.title: NBA Notes: Magic, Blazers, Deni Avdija, Warriors, Yaxel Lendeborg
results.description: The Cavaliers got a pretty good look Tuesday at what Orlando wants its offense to become. They probably would have preferred a less convincing demonstration.

results.title: Lookman relieved to end goal drought in Atletico win over Man United
results.description: Super Eagles forward Ademola Lookman expressed relief and delight after ending his goal drought to seal Atletico Madrid’s 2–0 win
